en.name: Cleopatra
en.ability: Each night, choose two players: if they nominate tomorrow, they die that night. Each day, if a good player (Travellers don't count) does not nominate, evil wins.

revisions.v1: Each night, choose two players: if they nominate tomorrow, they die that night. Each day, if a good player (Travellers don't count) does not nominate, evil wins.

en.flavor: "Fool! Don't you see now that I could have poisoned you a hundred times had I been able to live without you!" - Cleopatra VII Thea Philopator 69 B.C. - 30 B.C.
en.otherNightReminder: If a previously chosen player nominated today they die. Remove all CHOSEN tokens. Cleopatra points to two players. Place the CHOSEN token next to both players.

zh.name: 克里奥佩特拉
zh.ability: 每个夜晚，你要选择两名玩家：如果他们在明天白天发起提名，当晚他们会死亡。每个白天，如果没有善良玩家（旅行者不计算在内）发起提名，邪恶阵营获胜。

revisions.v1: 每个夜晚，你要选择两名玩家：如果他们在明天白天发起提名，当晚他们会死亡。每个白天，如果没有善良玩家（旅行者不计算在内）发起提名，邪恶阵营获胜。

zh.flavor: ‘蠢货！你没发现如果没有你我也能活下去，我已经能够给你下毒千百回了吗！’-克里奥佩特拉七世 笃爱父亲者 前69-前30
zh.firstNightReminder: 唤醒克里奥佩特拉，让她选择两名玩家。
zh.otherNightReminder: 唤醒克里奥佩特拉，让她选择两名玩家。如果前一天被选择的玩家在今天白天发起过提名，他（他们）死亡。
